An aggregation service may have any number of dependencies, but they must share the same service variation.

Back to STXA rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

An aggregation service may have any number of dependencies, but they must share the same service variation. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the Aggregation services family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STXA001: An aggregation service may have any number of dependencies, but they must share the same service variation.
class StudentAggregationService(
    IStudentService students,
    ICourseProcessingService courses) : IStudentAggregationService { }

Good code example

// Follows STXA001
class StudentAggregationService(
    IStudentService students,
    ICourseService courses) : IStudentAggregationService { }
